jessica_ae: Heads-up — MedCrest Health returned an order form + PO but their legal pushed DPA edits that mandate EU-only storage + customer HSM. Need quick alignment on signing flow and whether we can accept PO+eSign.

ron_se: Can you paste the clauses they changed? any explicit blocking asks?

jessica_ae: Pasted key bits from their redline:
```
3. DATA LOCATION: All patient data (PHI) must be stored and processed exclusively in eu-west-1.
7. KEY MANAGEMENT: Customer requires HSM-backed keys under their BYOK policy; Redwood must support import and attestations.
12. SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime, credit tiers, and 1-hour P1 response SLA.
```

priya_legal: Those are significant. BYOK + HSM and 1-hour P1 push us to Dedicated or Private. Hosted multi-tenant can't meet BYOK attestation today. We can offer: (A) Dedicated in eu-west-1 with KMS integration and a short SOW, or (B) Private VPC deployment. If they insist hosted+BYOK, that'll require custom engineering and a longer SOW + security review.

marco_procure: Procurement note — PO will be to "MedCrest EU Operations Ltd" net30. They asked if DocuSign is acceptable, and whether Redwood can countersign electronically. Also asked for invoice remit AP-eu@medcrest.health.

sam_sec: Security: We can produce SOC2 report and SCCs. For BYOK/HSM we need to capture key import procedures, control plane access, and audit evidence. Dedicated + KMS is the shortest path to meet their ask; Private gives the most assurances but takes longer. We should prepare a short security Q response. ETA 24h.

jessica_ae: Customer asked specifically: "Can we keep using hosted plan but with our keys?" Their buying team doesn't want a months-long private deployment. Any middle ground?

ron_se: Middle-ground possibility: a dedicated tenant instance in eu-west-1 with a customer KMS integration (we isolate workloads and map keys). That is effectively Dedicated. We can call it "Dedicated (EU) w/ customer KMS" in the term sheet. Tech-wise doable within ~2-3 weeks if infra prioritizes.

priya_legal: For signature routing: propose envelope order: 1) MedCrest CFO (signature) 2) MedCrest Legal (cc) 3) jessica_ae (sales) 4) priya_legal (Redwood legal). We should attach a redline summary and an execution note: "Execution of Order Form is without prejudice to final SOW for Key Management."

marco_procure: I will prepare the DocuSign envelope and request VAT certificate before invoicing. Also confirm billing entity: Redwood Inference Ltd (EU).

priya_legal: I'll prepare a 1-page redline summary and flag clauses requiring SOW (Key Mgmt, SLA tweak, data residency). Also add fallback SLA language if they can't accept Dedicated: either lower uptime or formal SOW.

sam_sec: I'll draft answers for the security questionnaire focusing on: key import workflow, HSM attestation options, audit logging, and access controls. Will include suggested compensating controls if they push hosted.

jessica_ae: PO# MC-2026-0098 — attaching here: https://files.internal/medcrest/PO_MC-2026-0098.pdf

sigbot: DocuSign envelope created by marco_procure at 2026-04-02T11:03Z 1: envelope_id: ds_env_9f8e7d

marco_procure: Envelope recipients set. Sending to MedCrest now. Adding note to envelope: "Refer to SOW MC-2026-SOW-01 for BYOK/HSM details."

jessica_ae: Thanks all. @priya_legal @sam_sec @ron_se please drop the redline summary + security Q answers here when ready and I'll forward to MedCrest. Will mark this as high priority.

priya_legal: Uploading redline summary shortly.

sam_sec: Security questionnaire draft posted in thread — will refine with Priya.

jessica_ae: Great — will update MedCrest after we have the docs.
